items.title: NousResearch/hermes-agent Hermes Agent v0.22.2
items.summary: Hermes Agent v0.22.2 is a patch release for the Nous Research coding agent that fixes a broken build in v0.22.1. It resolves issues with the Microsoft Store app connection and gateway stability.

items.title: can1357/oh-my-pi v18.11.0
items.summary: oh-my-pi v18.11.0 is a coding agent that integrates with IDEs. This release includes breaking changes to the approval details API and updates to the core agent logic.

items.title: drumih/turbo-fieldfare 0.9.3
items.summary: turbo-fieldfare 0.9.3 enables running Gemma 4 26B-A4B inference on M-series MacBooks using approximately 2 GB of RAM. This patch fixes a race condition that could crash the Mac app during connection closures.

items.title: mostlygeek/llama-swap v265
items.summary: llama-swap v265 is a tool for swapping models in local OpenAI or Anthropic compatible servers like llama.cpp and vLLM. This update adds support for serving behind a reverse proxy path and manual voice definitions.

items.title: affaan-m/ECC
items.summary: ECC is a performance optimization system for AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. It enhances agent capabilities through skills, memory, and security protocols.

items.title: mksglu/context-mode
items.summary: Context-mode optimizes the context window for AI coding agents by sandboxing tool output and persisting session memory. It reduces token usage significantly and works via MCP.

items.title: aannoo/hcom 0.7.30
items.summary: hcom is a tool that allows AI agents to message and spawn each other across different terminals. It supports integration with various coding agents like Claude Code and Codex.

items.title: anthropics/claude-plugins-official
items.summary: An official directory of high-quality plugins for Claude Code, maintained by Anthropic to extend the capabilities of their coding agent.

items.title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B: Built for fast on-device agents
items.summary: A new 24-billion parameter model with 2-billion active parameters designed specifically for fast on-device agent execution.

items.title: lightseekorg/tokenspeed
items.summary: TokenSpeed is a new LLM inference engine designed to maximize throughput and speed. It is notable for its focus on high-performance execution, which is critical for local and server-side deployment of large models.

items.title: Prompt injection in HTTP headers: what 217M web responses show
items.summary: A study of 217 million web responses identifies instances of prompt injection attacks embedded in HTTP headers. This highlights a significant supply chain security risk for AI agents that process web content.

items.title: Next.js Ships Out-of-Band Patch for Two Critical RCE Flaws in Caching and SVG Processing
items.summary: Next.js released an out-of-band security patch fixing two critical remote code execution flaws in caching and SVG processing. The update addresses unauthenticated RCE vulnerabilities in React Server Components and the librsvg library.

items.title: morluto/rea
items.summary: rea is a tool that uses AI agents to reverse engineer software, ranging from app behavior to native binaries. It has gained significant traction on GitHub for its automated analysis capabilities.

items.title: Infisical/infisical v0.166.7
items.summary: Infisical v0.166.7 is an open-source platform for managing secrets, certificates, and access for AI agents. This update improves the user interface for editing secret sheets and fixes billing display issues.

items.title: rociiu/talorys
items.summary: Talorys is a personal AI agent framework that deploys to Cloudflare. It provides chat, memory, and task management features with a focus on privacy and low cost.

items.title: OpenCode 2.0
items.summary: OpenCode 2.0 is a major release of a coding agent tool. It likely includes significant improvements to the agent's capabilities and user interface.

items.title: xerj-org/xerj
items.summary: XERJ is a data indexing tool for AI agents that reduces token usage compared to grep. It supports RAG and agent memory with Elasticsearch compatibility.

items.title: We found a Tencent agent fleet
items.summary: A report details the discovery of a fleet of AI agents operated by Tencent. This is significant for understanding the scale and potential security implications of autonomous agent deployments in the wild.

items.title: Agentic autofix for code scanning alerts general availability
items.summary: GitHub has made agentic autofix for code scanning alerts generally available. The feature uses AI agents to explore codebases, propose fixes for security alerts, and apply changes similarly to a human developer.

items.title: GhostAction Compromises About 1,900 GitHub Accounts, Targets Over 30,000 Repositories
items.summary: The GhostAction credential-theft campaign compromised approximately 1,900 GitHub accounts and targeted over 30,000 repositories. The attack attempted to extract secrets from public repositories and affected multiple organizations.

items.title: Researchers Used a Public OpenAI Model to Build a $250,000 Chrome Full-Chain Exploit in Six Days
items.summary: Security researchers used an AI agent running on a public LLM to chain three unknown Chrome vulnerabilities into a full exploit in six days. The incident demonstrates the growing capability of AI agents to autonomously discover and exploit complex software bugs.

items.title: Security researchers spent 6 days doing their Chromework, built 1B user exploit
items.summary: Security researchers built a Chrome exploit affecting one billion users in six days using AI assistance. The team earned a $250,000 bug bounty for the discovery.

items.title: An Israeli firm is sending spyware through online ads, researchers say
items.summary: Security researchers discovered a zero-click attack vector where spyware is delivered through online ads served by an Israeli ad tech firm, infecting devices without user interaction.

items.title: Aldrig set før: Nyt »zero-click« hack inficerer telefonen via annoncer
items.summary: A Danish report details a new zero-click hacking method where spyware is injected via targeted online ads, marking a shift from direct messaging attacks to ad-based infection vectors.

items.title: Fission-AI/OpenSpec v1.14.2 - Extension metadata, faster completion
items.summary: OpenSpec v1.14.2 is a tool for spec-driven development with AI coding assistants. This update adds support for custom extension metadata and improves the speed of tab completion features.

items.title: glanceapp/glance v0.8.7
items.summary: Glance v0.8.7 is a self-hosted dashboard for aggregating feeds and services. This release fixes data fetching issues for Reddit and AdGuard Home widgets following recent API changes.

items.title: 1jehuang/jcode v0.98.1
items.summary: jcode v0.98.1 is a high-performance coding agent harness written in Rust. The release reduces idle CPU usage and improves response richness for desktop clients.

items.title: onehumanbeing/esp32-iphone-agent
items.summary: esp32-iphone-agent allows an AI model to control a real iPhone using a $7 ESP32 board. It uses AirPlay for visual input and USB HID for actions, requiring no Mac, developer account, or jailbreak.

items.title: YeonwooSung/my-claude-code-mods
items.summary: A collection of custom modifications for Claude Code. It provides specific enhancements and configurations for the coding agent.

items.title: outcrawlai/scout
items.summary: Scout is an open-source browser agent developed by Outcrawl. It allows AI agents to interact with web browsers for automation tasks.

items.title: The Thinking Leakage in Reinforcement Learning for LLMs
items.summary: This paper analyzes 'thinking leakage' in hybrid reasoning models like Qwen3. It argues that performance gains from training in no-think mode are often due to the model retaining internal reasoning traces rather than genuine efficiency improvements.

items.title: ProgAgent: Learning Tool Orchestration through Programmatic Training
items.summary: ProgAgent introduces a training method for LLMs to orchestrate tools programmatically rather than through sequential direct calls. This approach aims to reduce context degradation and improve reliability in long-horizon agent tasks.

items.title: Amp puts AI agents to work beyond code with OpenAI models
items.summary: OpenAI announced new capabilities for its Amp agent platform, integrating GPT-6 Astra and other models to handle tasks beyond coding. The update includes features like Ultrafast processing and Sign in with ChatG to streamline agent workflows.

items.title: HydraFusion updates and new Max option
items.summary: GitHub updated HydraFusion with a new model pool and introduced HydraFusion Max. These updates improve orchestration workflows and are available across VS Code and the GitHub Copilot app.

items.title: Langflow's Critical Authenticated RCE Flaw Targeted in 1,423 Honeypot Exploit Attempts
items.summary: Threat actors are exploiting a critical authenticated remote code execution flaw in Langflow, an open-source platform for building AI applications. The vulnerability has been targeted in over 1,400 honeypot exploit attempts.

items.title: An AI Agent Found a Critical OTP Bypass in Production. The Attack Was the Easy Part.
items.summary: An AI pentesting agent independently discovered a critical authentication bypass in a production environment. The finding illustrates the practical application of AI agents in security auditing and the risks of unverified code generation.

items.title: Anthropic warns small AI models could self-replicate through IoT devices
items.summary: Anthropic researchers warn that small AI models could potentially self-replicate by exploiting vulnerabilities in Internet of Things devices, creating a new class of computer worms that spread autonomously.

items.title: Her er de alvorlige AI-hændelser, som EU i al hemmelighed er ved at undersøge: Kan blive første store prøvelse under AI Act
items.summary: The EU is secretly investigating severe AI incidents that may constitute the first major enforcement actions under the AI Act. These cases involve advanced AI models and represent a significant regulatory milestone for AI safety.

items.title: EU undersøger i al hemmelighed flere alvorlige AI-incidents: Offentligheden må intet få at vide
items.summary: EU authorities are investigating multiple serious incidents involving advanced AI models in secret. The public has not been informed of the specific details, but these investigations mark a new phase of regulatory scrutiny for AI systems.
Anthropic revealed that model distillation accounts for 5-7% of its revenue, indicating that other labs are spending hundreds of millions to replicate its models.
